jobs.name: Listing correspondence
jobs.prompt: Handle the user's correspondence with listing agents. The pre-run script has already recorded new replies and found the contact requests and replies that need you. Follow the contact skill: run its work command and handle every listing it lists, then stop. Nobody reads your final response. Anything the user must know goes through the contact skill's ask or tell commands.

jobs.name: Listing search
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of this hour's apartment search. If it names judgment task files, judge their listings as the search skill's section "Judging must-haves" says, one task file after another, until you have written the judgments of every task file. Do not contact anyone and do not change any settings. End with one line saying how many listings you judged.

jobs.name: Listing features
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of the listing features job. Follow the listing-features skill: run every extraction task in the report as its section "Running extraction tasks" says. Then, if the report names a readings task file, read the notes and preferences as its section "Reading notes and preferences" says. Then, if the report has judgment calls, run them as its section "Judging preferences stated later" says. Never look at a listing's photos or read an extraction or judgment task file yourself. Do not contact listing agents and do not change any settings. End with one line saying how many listings were extracted, how many notes and preferences were read and how many listings were judged.

jobs.name: Ranking review
jobs.prompt: Above is the report of the ranking review job. Follow the ranking skill's section "Review pass": read the review task file the report names with read_file, write the review it asks for to the file it names with write_file, then stop. If the report shows a script error instead of a task file, end with that error as your final answer. Do not contact anyone and do not change any settings. End with the one line the task file asks for.
